title: How to
text: To convert an improper fraction to a mixed number, divide the denominator into the numerator.

title: Divide
text: What is $$11$$ divided by 6? Write the answer as 'Quotient R Remainder' (e.g., '1 R 5').

title: Write as mixed number
text: The quotient is the whole number, the remainder is the new numerator, and the divisor is the denominator.
